follow-up time: Intrapartum, within a 30-minute window before delivery
exposure: Fetal heart rate patterns, specifically slope deceleration features
cohort: 502 infants born at Miguel Servet University Hospital in Spain, with an equal number of cases (acidemia) and controls (no acidemia).
finding: Machine learning algorithms, particularly random forest and logistic regression models, effectively predicted neonatal acidemia based on fetal heart rate features, potentially reducing unnecessary cesarean sections.
